title: helm(private): values schema + init hooks rollback compatibility refactor
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private hit upgrade failures when Helm init hooks create cluster resources that the upgrade job later relies on. This PR refactors the init hooks and values schema to improve upgrade/rollback compatibility, make the values file more explicit for VPC/on-prem installs, and add safer templating for CRD/init job ordering. The change set includes: 1) Values schema expansion (explicit imagePullSecrets, initJob.enabled, initJob.retryPolicy, crdManager.resources), 2) Helm template changes to make init jobs idempotent and tolerations optional, 3) new pre-upgrade hook that validates existing resources and writes a rollback marker, 4) rollback compatibility logic to skip destructive changes when a rollback marker exists, 5) docs and example values for private VPC installs, and 6) chart/unit tests + integration test scenario for upgrade/rollback. Checklist: - [x] Values schema + JSON schema validation - [x] Make hooks idempotent and add retryPolicy - [x] Add rollback marker + detection logic - [x] Update example values for on-prem and VPC - [x] Add helm chart tests and CI job - [x] Docs updated (docs/private/helm.md) Breaking notes: non-breaking for typical installs, but operators who rely on old implicit defaults should review the new explicit values (imagePullSecrets, tolerations, initJob.enabled). See release notes.
commits: refactor(helm): extract init-job template and add idempotency checks
feat(helm): add rollback-marker pre-upgrade hook and detection logic
chore(helm): extend values.schema.json for private installs and add examples
test(helm): add chart tests for upgrade -> rollback scenario
docs: update docs/private/helm.md with upgrade/rollback guidance
review_comments: Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Left a couple of small nits on templating; please avoid using include + tpl for values that could be validated in schema. Also can we reduce the default initJob.cpu requests?

Maya Patel (author): Reply: good call on schema validation — moved the default logic into values.schema.json and removed extra tpl usage. Reduced initJob CPU from 200m to 100m for default to keep footprint small.

Priya Sharma (reviewer): Suggestion: pre-upgrade hook should write a ConfigMap as a rollback marker instead of touching CRs to minimize RBAC scope. Also asked for an e2e scenario in chart tests that simulates a failed post-upgrade job.

Maya Patel (author): Reply: switched rollback marker to ConfigMap and added role that grants minimal permissions. Added an upgrade-rollback chart test that runs a failing post-upgrade job and verifies rollback marker prevents destructive CR changes.
Diego Martinez (approver): Approved after fixes. Left one comment to add a short line in the docs about operators who pin image tags to avoid surprises.
ci_checks: chart tests (k8s-in-docker): failed on first run (timeout in upgrade-rollback scenario)
chart tests: re-run passed after increasing timeout and adding retryPolicy to init job
release_notes: Private Helm chart: improved values schema for on-prem and VPC installs (explicit imagePullSecrets, tolerations, initJob settings)
Init hooks: idempotent init-job templates and retryPolicy to improve upgrade reliability
Upgrade/rollback: added pre-upgrade rollback marker and compatibility logic to avoid destructive changes on rollback
Docs: updated private Helm docs with upgrade/rollback guidance and example values
